root_cause.text: The `amdgpu_userq_wait_ioctl` function in the AMDGPU driver fails to release the reference to the retrieved `dma_fence` object when aborting early due to the output array being too small, resulting in a reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `dma_fence_put(fence)` was added before jumping to `free_fences` when the condition `WARN_ON_ONCE(num_fences >= wait_info->num_fences)` is met in `amdgpu_userq_fence.c`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a dma_fence reference leak in amdgpu_userq_wait_ioctl when the number of unwrapped fences exceeds the requested limit.
intent_record.what: Added a call to dma_fence_put(fence) inside the error path of the dma_fence_unwrap_for_each loop when the fence count limit is exceeded.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the reference count of the current fence is properly decremented before jumping to the error cleanup label, preventing a resource leak.
